summary: P0 search bug fix verified. yfinance fuzzy lookup now resolves full company names to correct tickers (Salesforce->CRM, Abbott Laboratories->ABT). All 13 pytest backend tests passed including fuzzy name lookup, direct ticker (AAPL/CRM), exchange filters (US-only, NSE-only), foreign exchange exclusion, and regression on /api/stocks/AAPL/quote, /api/price-alerts, /api/pinned-stocks. Frontend smoke test confirmed App.js refactor (CategoryIcon, SortablePinnedStock, backgroundOptions extracted) caused no regression: page loads with zero console errors, search bar dropdown shows CRM for 'Salesforce' and ABT for 'Abbott Laboratories', pinned stocks (GOOGL/AAPL/MSFT) render with drag handles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3656 lines — well above the 700 line guideline; recommend modularization (routers/services per resource) in a future refactor pass.
search_stocks endpoint inline-defines large dicts (us_stocks/nse_stocks/bse_stocks) on every request — move to module-level constants for memory and clarity.
Local variable name 'search_stocks' inside search_stocks() shadows the outer function name; rename to 'predefined_stocks' for readability.
yfinance Search is rate-limit prone; consider in-process caching (e.g. TTL 60s) on the query->results to reduce upstream calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Search endpoint at /api/stocks/search now supplements predefined dicts with yf.Search() fuzzy lookup. Foreign exchange tickers (containing dot/dash but not .NS/.BO) are filtered out, indices (^) kept. Exchange filter 'us'/'nse'/'bse'/'all' tested and works. Frontend search-bar testid is 'stock-search-input'; access-code input testid is 'access-code-input'. Pinned stocks render via SortablePinnedStock component — visible drag handles confirmed.
